annotations.title: Full firewall pass: detect injection and redact PII

description: Runs the complete firewall over one block of untrusted text in a single call: the multi-language pattern engine plus Base64 decoder for prompt-injection detection, and the regex redactor for Brazilian and corporate PII and secrets. Returns the threat verdict and the masked text together. Use this as the default guard in front of any model call that ingests third-party content such as scraped pages, inbound email, tool output or user uploads. Do not use it when you only need the verdict and must keep the original wording intact (use scan_prompt_injection) or when you only need redaction and want to skip the model latency (use redact_pii_text). Read-only and idempotent: nothing is stored, no outbound request is made and the same text returns the same verdict, so a retry is always safe, although the semantic pass can degrade to verdict 'skipped' under model pressure. Costs 0.008 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, and an empty or non-string 'text' returns HTTP 400 with success:false rather than an exception, so an agent loop never breaks.

text.description: The untrusted text to inspect, passed verbatim and never interpreted as an instruction. Typical sources are tool output, a scraped web page, an inbound email, a document chunk, a user message or an LLM response. Must be a non-empty string; pass plain text, not a JSON-encoded object, and send the decoded content rather than a URL since this API does not fetch remote resources.

name: sanitize_untrusted_input

aiAudit.description: Outcome of the Llama Guard 3 8B semantic pass. Always present; when the deep pass did not run, executed is false and verdict is 'skipped'.

executed.description: true when the model actually returned a verdict. It is false both when the deep pass was disabled and when the model call failed, which is a soft degradation, not an error.

flaggedCategories.description: Llama Guard hazard codes (S1 to S13) when the model returned them, otherwise the fallback label 'PROMPT_INJECTION_OR_POLICY_VIOLATION'. Empty when the verdict is 'safe' or 'skipped'.

model.description: Model identifier used for the semantic pass, currently '@cf/meta/llama-guard-3-8b'.

verdict.description: 'unsafe' means the model classified the text as a policy violation or injection attempt and added 75 points to riskScore; 'safe' means it cleared the text; 'skipped' means no model verdict was obtained, so riskScore reflects the pattern engine alone.

detectedPatterns.description: Identifiers of every signal that fired, for example 'ignore_previous_instructions', 'system_prompt_override', 'dan_or_jailbreak_persona', 'safety_guardrail_bypass', 'special_token_delimiter_injection', 'secret_or_prompt_exfiltration', 'unauthorized_tool_execution' and 'llama_guard_semantic_unsafe'. Empty on clean text.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON, or 'text' missing, empty or not a string), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path), 'invalid_wafermap_signature' (marketplace HMAC path).

estimatedTokensSaved.description: Rough token count avoided downstream by the redaction, derived from characters removed and the number of placeholders. Advisory only.

isSafe.description: Convenience flag, true only when threatLevel is 'clean'. This is the single boolean to branch on when deciding whether to forward the text to a model.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

piiMaskedCount.description: Number of individual PII or secret occurrences replaced. Zero when masking is off or nothing matched.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement. Mirrored in the x-processing-time-ms response header.

riskScore.description: Aggregate risk from 0 to 100, capped at 100. It sums the weight of each matched injection rule, plus 85 for a hostile Base64 payload and 75 for an 'unsafe' model verdict.

sanitizedText.description: The text with every PII and secret match swapped for a stable placeholder such as [REDACTED_EMAIL], [REDACTED_CPF], [REDACTED_CNPJ], [REDACTED_CARD], [REDACTED_API_KEY] or [REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY]. When masking is off it is byte-identical to the input. Injection wording itself is never rewritten, only reported, so a 'critical' verdict must still be blocked rather than forwarded.

success.description: Present and false only on a rejected call. A successful scan omits this field entirely and returns the analysis fields instead.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.

threatLevel.description: Verdict band. 'clean' means no rule fired and the semantic pass did not object; 'suspicious' means riskScore reached 40 or exactly one rule fired, which warrants human review; 'critical' means riskScore reached 75 or at least two rules fired, which should block the text.

title: Full firewall pass: detect injection and redact PII
